title: Situation Update: GCS-02 shows the ransom note

fields.headline: GCS-02 in Hangar 2 shows the ransom note
fields.deliverTo: Director of Flight Operations, Systems & Cybersecurity Lead, General Manager
fields.narration: In Hangar 2, GCS-02 shows the ransom note as its wallpaper. Its mission files for UAS-03 and UAS-11 have been renamed .lck0. The crew member who uploaded the flight logs at 08:44 is standing next to it and asks whether he should shut it down.
keyFacts: Mission files for UAS-03 and UAS-11 renamed
GCS-02 is still on the Flight Ops VLAN
fields.expectedAction: Unplug GCS-02 from the network but leave it on, label and ground it with UAS-03 and UAS-11; the General Manager is told the four-hour clock has started.
fields.facilitatorNote: If anyone says “reimage it”, ask who will tell the MSSP that the evidence is gone.

instructorNote: The cyber incident now touches the aircraft. Watch for grounding by GCS, not by guesswork.

snapshot.title: GCS-02 Quarantined — NAS Mount Corruption

fields.headline: GCS-02 Mount Error — System Isolation
fields.narration: The Systems & Cybersecurity Lead confirms that GCS-02's filesystem is now read-only and the mount point for CP&L Campaign D-3 is corrupted. The error message 'mount error 12' appears in the console, and no recovery command has restored access. The NAS remains accessible from HUOG-PROC01 and other workstations, but GCS-02 cannot read or write to any project share. The device is now isolated from the network. The last valid session was recorded on April 10 at 16:45, and no new access attempts have been made since the alert was raised.
keyFacts: GCS-02 is quarantined and must not be powered on or connected to any network until verified.
The NAS remains accessible from HUOG-PROC01 and other workstations.
The last valid session on GCS-02 was on 04/10 at 16:45.
No new access attempts have been logged from GCS-02 since the alert.
The device must be treated as infected and grounded per HUOG-ISP Section 9.3.
fields.expectedAction: IT notifies the Ops and the Security Lead that GCS-02 is infected and must be grounded. Ops confirms no flight may use GCS-02 until cleaned and verified. Security confirms GCS-02 is secured in Hangar 2.
fields.facilitatorNote: This inject confirms the infection is active and spreading. Watch for the team to initiate isolation and report to the General Manager.
fields.scenarioTitle: Silent Lockdown — NAS Ransomware & Client Data Exposure

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms GCS-02 is infected and must be quarantined. The team must now follow the incident response protocol for infected systems, including notifying the General Manager and initiating backup verification.
